concept: A cozy pocket cinema where a blank screen, velvet seats, and warm projector light turn quiet evenings into little adventures.
floor: One broad continuous midnight-navy cinema carpet across the full top face, with a smooth softly beveled surface and subtle large-scale tonal variation but no fibers, stars, dots, stripes, medallion, seams, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One broad blank deep-blue cinema screen at the rear framed by two simple burgundy curtains and a chunky rounded navy canopy.
rear_props: one large simplified projector with one oversized reel form
side_props: one paired burgundy velvet seat and one chunky popcorn tub along the upper-left edge
one paired burgundy velvet seat and one compact popcorn stand along the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth upholstered cinema border made from broad navy and burgundy masses
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple gold film-reel emblems

lighting: soft dim cinema ambience with one broad cool screen fill and two restrained amber lantern glows
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open midnight-navy carpet
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, distinct rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, image baked onto the screen, text, watermark, external shadow
grass, flowers, shrubs, carpet fibers, star patterns, tiny bulbs, film perforations, scattered popcorn, specks, or dense cinema clutter
